comment: Gzip ceilings in bytes for each entry, measured with every chunk it imports. The dist is not minified (comments count); minified, an entry is about half this. A guardrail against accidental bloat (a leaked dependency, duplicated data), not a per-phase target. Bump deliberately, with a reason, at a release. index.js was 15624 at 0.1.0; raised from 48 KB to 64 KB for 0.2.0, which adds the player, its themes and the volume control (index 48447 and player 41791 when raised).
